cues.en: Welcome to this section of the course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到這一節。

cues.en: I hope you found the previous section to be exhilarating, fun and challenging, but also manageable.
cues.zh: 希望你覺得上一節令人振奮、有趣、有挑戰，但仍能掌握。

cues.en: You know, calculus is such a beautiful and fascinating part of math.
cues.zh: 微積分真的是數學裡美麗又迷人的部分。

cues.en: I really enjoy working through the problems, going through the proofs.
cues.zh: 我很喜歡解題、看證明。

cues.en: And what I especially love about calculus is that you can visualize almost everything that's actually
cues.zh: 我特別喜歡微積分的一點，是幾乎所有東西都能視覺化。這在

cues.en: kind of rare in math, like in linear algebra, for example, You can really only visualize the basic
cues.zh: 數學裡其實很少見，例如線性代數，只能把基礎

cues.en: stuff because it very quickly gets into higher dimensional sub spaces that are just impossible to visualize.
cues.zh: 內容畫出來，因為很快就會進入無法視覺化的高維子空間。

cues.en: But calculus is something that you can always just plot and look at, at least until you get to higher dimensional calculus.
cues.zh: 但微積分總可以畫圖、觀察，至少到高維微積分之前都可以。

cues.en: Anyway, let me say a few quick words about this section.
cues.zh: 總之，我簡單介紹這一節。

cues.en: This section is all about using the limits definition of derivatives to discover important rules and
cues.zh: 這一節要利用導數的極限定義，發現重要的法則、

cues.en: theorems and ways to differentiate common functions.
cues.zh: 定理，以及常見函數的微分方法。

cues.en: Now, the cool thing about this section is that there isn't much new foundational work to learn.
cues.zh: 很棒的是，這一節沒有太多新的基礎要學。

cues.en: Instead, this section is all about applying the techniques that you already know to make new discoveries.
cues.zh: 而是運用你已知的技巧，做出新發現。

cues.en: But it's not just practice.
cues.zh: 但不只是練習。

cues.en: You know the rules that you will learn in this section, including like the product rule, the quotient rule, the chain rule, implicit differentiation.
cues.zh: 你會學到的法則，包括乘法法則、商法則、鏈鎖律、隱微分，

cues.en: These are absolutely critical for making any real progress in advanced calculus and certainly for making progress in applications of calculus.
cues.zh: 對於真正進展到高等微積分，以及微積分的應用，都是絕對必要的。

cues.en: Now, to be honest, the material in this section is where calculus starts getting difficult for a lot of people.
cues.zh: 老實說，這一節的內容，就是很多人開始覺得微積分困難的地方。

cues.en: The rules and the techniques and the theorems are sometimes sensible, but also very often unintuitive.
cues.zh: 法則、技巧與定理，有時合理，但也經常不直觀。

cues.en: Some of the proofs that will go through are a little weird.
cues.zh: 有些證明有點奇怪，

cues.en: They rely on some tricks that might make sense when you see them, but they're not things you would have thought up on your own.
cues.zh: 仰賴一些看到時可以理解，卻不會自己想到的技巧。

cues.en: And also, to be honest, there's just a lot of things that you need to memorize.
cues.zh: 而且老實說，需要記住的東西真的很多。

cues.en: So my teaching philosophy when I was creating these videos in this section was to try to find the balance
cues.zh: 所以製作這一節影片時，我的教學理念，是試著取得平衡，

cues.en: between making the rules intuitive and sensible, while also making things easier to memorize and and
cues.zh: 讓法則直觀、合理，也讓東西容易記，

cues.en: of course, relying on visualizations that I hope will help you internalize these concepts.
cues.zh: 當然還會仰賴視覺化，希望能幫你內化概念。

cues.en: And I also designed the code challenges to help you with these concepts and help you build intuition.
cues.zh: 我也設計程式挑戰，幫助你理解概念、建立直覺。

cues.en: But you're also going to need to work through problems by hand if you really want these differentiation rules to become second nature, to be really familiar with them.
cues.zh: 但如果真的希望這些微分法則成為自然反應、真正熟悉，仍然需要手算題目。

cues.en: So and another thing I've tried to do is link concepts across the different videos to help you see the connections between the different rules.
cues.zh: 另一件我試著做的事，是連結不同影片的概念，幫你看見法則間的關係。

cues.en: So what should you keep in mind as you are going through this section?
cues.zh: 那學這一節時，該記住什麼？

cues.en: What are the themes of this section?
cues.zh: 這一節的主軸是什麼？

cues.en: So in terms of calculus, the thing to keep in mind is that you're learning the rules that will allow you to progress to more advanced topics.
cues.zh: 微積分方面，記得你正在學能帶你進入更進階主題的法則。

cues.en: These rules are real bottlenecks and you're not going to get very far in calculus without the material in this section.
cues.zh: 這些法則是真正的瓶頸，沒有這一節的內容，微積分學不遠。

cues.en: So my advice for working through this section is that unless you're taking a proofs based calculus course,
cues.zh: 所以我的建議是，除非你正在上以證明為主的微積分課，

cues.en: then don't focus too much on memorizing the proofs.
cues.zh: 不然別太著重背證明。

cues.en: Make sure you understand them.
cues.zh: 確保理解就好。

cues.en: You want to go through the proofs at least once, you want to understand them once, but then you can focus on memorizing the rule or memorizing the algorithm.
cues.zh: 至少完整看一次、理解一次證明，之後就可以專心記住法則或演算法。

cues.en: And don't worry too much about the intricacies and the tricks involved in working through the proofs.
cues.zh: 不必太擔心證明過程裡複雜的細節與技巧。

cues.en: And also in terms of your experience as a student, the thing to keep in mind is that this is where calculus starts to become challenging.
cues.zh: 就學習者的經驗而言，也記得這裡是微積分開始有挑戰的地方。

cues.en: Don't be afraid of that challenge.
cues.zh: 不要害怕挑戰。

cues.en: Don't be afraid of the difficulty.
cues.zh: 不要害怕困難。

cues.en: Instead, use that as an opportunity to challenge yourself, to stick with it, to persevere, take notes, solve problems, and practice problems and coding exercises.
cues.zh: 把它當成挑戰自己的機會，堅持、持續下去，做筆記、解題、練習題目和程式。

cues.en: Pause the video where I tell you to work through problems on your own before watching my solution and hearing me discuss the problems and the solutions.
cues.zh: 我請你暫停影片時，就先自己算，再看我的解法、聽我討論題目與答案。

cues.en: I guess what I'm trying to say is that you need to let yourself suffer a little bit in order to break through and really understand the material.
cues.zh: 我想說的是，你需要讓自己稍微吃點苦，才能突破、真正理解教材。

cues.en: And with that said, let's get down to business.
cues.zh: 那麼開始認真做吧。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
